title: Tablet wall dive with sliding screen reel
summary: The camera pushes from a wall of landscape tablets into the centre one; its screens slide down one after another every 1.5 s, the strip showing past the bezel, then the camera pulls back out to the wall.
use_when: Showing 3-5 screens of a tablet or landscape app without any copy
A short silent loop for a product page, gallery or social feed
Placeholder-first: screenshots are ready but there is no story or VO yet
Opening a longer device showcase with a wall-to-hero camera move

look.type_style: only placeholder labels on the screens: medium geometric sans, centred, about 6 % of frame height; no headline copy

sfx.event: camera pushes from the wall into the centre tablet
screen strip slides down to the next screen
camera pulls back out to the wall

structure.shot: 3x3 wall of black-bezel landscape tablets on dark violet, each screen a flat tint; camera dives into the centre one
structure.camera: push-in on the centre tablet: its width 0.39 W -> 0.75 W (about 1.0 -> 1.9) over 25 fr (f0-f25), background violet -> grey -> pale
structure.motion: springs.cameraIn 25 fr, decelerating, settles by f30 (overshoot not measurable, ±0.25 s); neighbours leave frame by f15

structure.shot: hero tablet centred on pale blue-white; first screen (white, label + 3-line caption) slides down, saturated blue screen enters from the top
structure.camera: settle 1.9 -> 2.0 by f38, then locked (motion.json zoom <= 1 %/s)
structure.motion: screen strip moves down one screen height: start f31, easings.inOutCubic 38 fr, covered share 22/52/80/93/98 % at 0.25 s steps; strip runs past the bezel above and below the device

structure.shot: blue screen slides down, light-blue screen enters from the top; outgoing screen visible below the bezel
structure.motion: same slide: start f76, easings.inOutCubic 38 fr, hold 7 fr; period 45 fr

structure.shot: light-blue screen slides down, white screen enters from the top
structure.motion: same slide: start f121, easings.inOutCubic 38 fr, hold 7 fr

structure.shot: white screen slides down, blue screen enters from the top and holds
structure.motion: same slide: start f166, easings.inOutCubic 38 fr, hold 2 fr before the pull-out

structure.shot: camera backs out of the hero tablet to the same 3x3 wall on dark violet; centre screen now blue
structure.camera: pull-out: centre tablet width 0.71 W at 7.00 -> 0.40 W at 7.77 (about 2.0 -> 1.0) over 24 fr (f206-f230), background pale -> grey -> violet
structure.motion: springs.cameraOut 24 fr, decelerating (±0.25 s); neighbours enter from the edges by f218; holds f230-f240

params.brand: any brand.json: bg for the hero backdrop, surface/fg for the wall background, accent for screen tints
params.content.screens: 3-5 landscape screenshots (4:3, e.g. 1180x820), in reel order; the first is shown during the dive
params.content.wall: 8 tints or thumbnails for the neighbour tablets on the wall (default: repeat screens)
params.aspect: other (4:3 like the reference) | 16:9 | 1:1 | 4:5; the hero tablet fills about 75 % of width
params.timing.period: frames at 30 fps per screen (default 45 = 38 fr slide + 7 fr hold), scaled to fps
params.overflow: show the strip past the bezel above and below the device (default true)

notes: Measured from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s). The device is a flat front-on landscape tablet; device-phone is the nearest framed-device id in the vocabulary (proposed term: device-tablet). The screen strip is wider than the screen and continues outside the bezel at reduced width (about 0.57 W vs 0.81 W device), so the incoming and outgoing screens show above and below the device: proposed term screen-reel-overflow. Slides are always downward, 45 fr period, 38 fr move. Last cell matches the first wall layout but the centre screen differs (blue vs white), so loopable is false; making the last reel screen equal to the first makes it a seamless loop. No audio in the reference: sfx planned by the glue rule, not measured.
